licenses.reason: Prints dependency license notices bundled in gh; there is no server request or GHES-specific behavior. The case asserts the real offline output.

repo create.reason: Includes initialized, source/push, clone, team, template, and internal-visibility paths. Ordinary GHES features remain success assertions even where Codeyard currently lacks implementation; these are compatibility failures, not unsupported-on-GHES exceptions.

repo edit.reason: Ordinary repository settings assert persisted changes, not merely exit zero. Security-analysis enablement separately asserts the explicit HTTP 422 refusal of this host without those services; GHES can refuse unlicensed security features. No ordinary settings are waived for Codeyard implementation gaps.

repo set-default.reason: Uses a case-owned Git checkout/config and a live repository for the explicit default selection; view/unset verify the local config without changing shared account configuration.
